paragraphs: The X6 M60i is the current V8 flagship of the G06 X6 range, introduced in 2020 as the successor to the F16-generation xDrive50i. It uses a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 — part of BMW's N63 engine family, though the exact engine code for the G06 M60i application is pending confirmation. It sits above the xDrive40i six-cylinder and xDrive30d diesel in the range, and below the full X6 M. The V8 powertrain is shared with the G05 X5 M60i of the same era, reflecting the platform-sharing relationship between the two models.
about.boldParagraph: The X6 M60i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
